answer: Sybil resistance via emission-timing entropy: at payout the ledger fingerprints each identity's arrival micro-pattern -- inter-tx gaps, nonce drift, gas-choice habits, RPC endpoints -- into a signature. Identities whose timestamps step in lockstep with a sibling across a delta of milliseconds, or whose nonce windows overlap like a doubled mirror, get folded into one contributor cluster and split a single share. A prism spreads entropy, but scripted puppets leak it; an ivory ledger keeps only distinct hums, so a farm that sounds identical collapses into one voice and one reward.
